tldr: Venus in Scorpio: love is intense, private, and transformative.
body: With Venus in Scorpio, attraction wants depth, loyalty, truth, and emotional risk. Venus is in detriment here, so attachment can become all-or-nothing until trust is handled consciously.
gift: Magnetism, loyalty, emotional courage, and the capacity for deep intimacy.
challenge: Jealousy, control, secrecy, and testing love instead of receiving it.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
